options.title: Rain arriving at a printmaker bicycle delivery
options.purpose: Keep a stack of fresh exhibition prints dry while securing them on a cargo bicycle.
options.difficulty: The first wind-driven rain lifts the protective sheet at a sheltered shop doorway.
options.current_action: One palm holds down the sheet while the other draws a strap through the cargo rack.
options.visible_result: The covered stack stays aligned and one edge of the sheet is taut; droplets gather on the lower rack.
options.autumn_outfit: cotton trench over a rib-knit cardigan, corduroy trousers and ankle boots

options.title: Closing an autumn greenhouse seed collection
options.purpose: Finish bundling dried seed specimens before the greenhouse door closes.
options.difficulty: A draft from the cracked door turns loose seed envelopes across the workbench.
options.current_action: The subject pins one open folio with a hand and slides the remaining envelope beneath its elastic.
options.visible_result: Two envelopes are secured inside the folio while one lifted paper corner shows the remaining disturbance.
options.autumn_outfit: wool field coat over a cable-knit vest and poplin shirt, pleated skirt and tall boots

options.title: Saving a painted backdrop at a rooftop theatre rehearsal
options.purpose: Hold a loosened scenic curtain so the small rehearsal can continue.
options.difficulty: An autumn gust curls the unweighted corner toward the subject.
options.current_action: The subject loops the corner through a heavy ring on a low rail.
options.visible_result: The secured corner drops into a narrow vertical fold while the free upper fabric is still billowing.
options.autumn_outfit: cropped tweed jacket over a fine roll-neck, a checked wool skirt and soft leather boots

options.title: Bundling dried flowers while the last ferry boards
options.purpose: Protect a bouquet of dried flowers for a crossing.
options.difficulty: A crosswind entering the quay shelter peels the kraft-paper wrap open.
options.current_action: The subject pulls twine across the wrap against a waist-height wooden packing ledge.
options.visible_result: The paper closes around the fragile stems and loose grasses lean with the wind.
options.autumn_outfit: suede short jacket over a brushed wool cardigan and cotton shirt, straight wool trousers and leather ankle boots

options.title: A ceramic exhibition crate waiting for a rain break
options.purpose: Place padded ceramic cups into a travel crate for a small exhibition.
options.difficulty: A wet courtyard narrows the dry loading space under the awning.
options.current_action: The subject lowers a wrapped cup into the crate while holding back a folded cloth divider.
options.visible_result: One padded cup already stands protected in the next compartment and the divider opens a receiving slot.
options.autumn_outfit: a wool waistcoat beneath an open canvas chore jacket, rib-knit top, pleated trousers and boots

requester_ownership_note: The user owns the autumn-fashion test topic, complexity and use of the supplied reference. All listed scene circumstances, wardrobe specifics, action, pose, setting and framing are agent-owned choices in open scope.

creative_control_interpretation.realization: Subtle everyday attraction through the subject's attentive presence and tactile, comfortably worn autumn layers. Concrete ordinary physics and a connected practical event carry the scene; the detailed fiction is an authorial choice.

authorial_direction_comparison.overhead_tether_version: The same loose backdrop could be caught overhead, making reach and a diagonal silhouette the carrying relationship.
authorial_direction_comparison.waist_ring_version: A waist-height ring lets both supported hands alter fabric tension while the neck, cuffs, skirt folds and boot support remain visible.
authorial_direction_comparison.selection_reason: The waist-ring version better connects the practical repair to observable garment layers in one frame; both versions preserve the autumn-fashion and reference-use meaning.

theme.who: A generated adult fashion subject working to hold the scenic canvas for rehearsal.
theme.where: A dry rooftop theatre deck with a rail and open rehearsal door.
theme.why_now: A gust has lifted the free corner; the held loop is already changing the cloth but the upper section remains under wind pressure.
theme.viewer_position: An environmental three-quarter view close enough to read hands, face and autumn textiles, without taking the subject out of the work.

planned_fashion_observations.observable: Cropped jacket with a nubby cocoa-and-charcoal flecked weave.
Cream rib-knit collar above the jacket collar and knit cuffs beyond tweed sleeves.
Cropped jacket hem exposes the checked skirt waistband and opening box pleat; the checked pattern turns with the pleat folds.
Knee boots remain visible with leather ankle creases carrying her planted weight.
